hero.lead: Wedding, pre-wedding, events and personal stories — photographed and filmed slowly, with intention, so they can be revisited long after the day is gone.

wedding.title: Wedding
wedding.desc: Full-day photo, film, or both. Intimate ceremonies, elopements and receptions across Bali.

prewedding.title: Pre-wedding
prewedding.desc: A slow session in the place you chose Bali for — cliffs, rice terraces, or the quiet beach at dawn.

event.title: Event
event.desc: Corporate gatherings, community celebrations, launches. Documented, not staged.

personal.title: Personal
personal.desc: Personal branding, graduation, family portraits. One hour, one location, you.

behind.line2: Just the person who was there.
behind.body: Lintas Waktu is run independently. From the first conversation to the day you receive your files, you work directly with the photographer — the same person who stood beside you on the day and remembers how it felt.

steps.title: Conversation
steps.desc: We talk about your day, not a price list.

steps.title: The day
steps.desc: Present, quiet, never in the way.

steps.title: Choose your photos
steps.desc: A private online gallery. Pick what you love, leave a note.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.desc: Edited, printed if you like, kept for years.

testimonial.quote: “We didn’t notice him most of the day. Then the photos came and it was like being there again — the light, the noise, my mother laughing.”
testimonial.name: Ayu & Marco

packages.line1: Three ways to keep the day.

cta.body: Dates in Bali fill quickly in the dry season (May–September). A short message is enough to start — we’ll reply within a day.

work.lead: A selection of weddings, sessions and events across Bali. Every set is edited by hand; nothing here is a preset.
